title: UMH Governed Operation Lifecycle Record
description: Target-state contract for one governed operation moving through the control plane: intent -> desired/current state diff -> policy decision -> approval -> work packets -> execution steps (adapter/tool calls on runtime nodes/sessions) -> proof artifacts -> trace events -> evaluation -> state commit -> memory candidates -> rollback. This is the convergence target shape; today the lifecycle is split across substrate/execution/spine.py (8-stage pipeline), substrate/organism/governed_spine.py, substrate/control_plane/governance.py, and substrate/execution/trace.py, with no single durable operation record (see GAP-B1-010, GAP-B1-012).

operation_id.description: Globally unique, durable operation identifier. Single ID namespace for the whole lifecycle (replaces the coexisting apk-/apvl-/uappr- prefixes noted in B3).

intent.description: Operator or agent intent that originated the operation, with its source signal reference.

initiator.description: Identity of the human operator or agent instance that raised the intent.

desired_state.description: Declarative description of the target state of the external/internal entities the operation reconciles toward.

current_state.description: Observed state at operation start (from the relevant state authority), against which the gap is computed.

gap.description: Computed delta between desired_state and current_state that this operation closes.

risk_class.description: Deterministic risk classification assigned by the policy engine (substrate/control_plane/governance.py).

policy_decision.description: Outcome of policy-engine evaluation (today: GovernanceVerdict / PipelineGovernanceVerdict in substrate/types.py; convergence target is a single verdict type with a scope discriminator).

policy_version.description: Identifier/version of the policy evaluated against (missing field flagged by B3 for GovernanceVerdict).

permission_envelope.description: Reference to the permission envelope the operation is confined to.

blast_radius.description: Declared blast radius of the operation (systems/entities reachable if it misbehaves).

approval.description: Human authorization state. Blocks execution for HIGH/CRITICAL risk classes until decided.

approver.description: Identity of the deciding human operator (null while pending or when not required).

channel.description: Surface the approval was requested/decided on.

work_packets.description: IDs of work packets decomposed from this operation (see work_packet.schema.json).

execution_steps.description: Ordered execution steps. ExecutionStep is a MISSING primitive today (B2); this defines its target shape: every step records the adapter or tool call it made and where it ran.

adapter_call.description: Reference to the adapter contract invocation (adapter id + method + argument digest), when the step went through an adapter.

tool_call.description: Reference to the tool invocation (tool name + argument digest), when the step was a direct tool call.

runtime_node.description: Node id from the device/node registry (infra/device_registry.json) the step executed on.

runtime_session.description: Runtime session identifier (interactive desktop session, tmux session, container, subprocess group) the step ran inside.

proof_artifacts.description: Evidence produced by execution, satisfying the operation's proof contract. Each entry references an artifact by id/URI plus its type.

trace_events.description: Ordered trace event references for the full lifecycle (recorded today via substrate/execution/trace.py; convergence target is one trace per operation_id).

evaluation_result.description: Post-execution evaluation: did the observed state converge to the desired state, and at what quality (today: quality scoring in substrate/execution/feedback.py).

state_commit.description: Reference to the durable state commit recording the post-operation observed state against the owning state authority. StateCommit is a MISSING primitive today (B3); this is its target linkage.

state_authority.description: The declared source of truth the commit was written to (state authority domain, e.g. from substrate/organism/state_authority_graph.py).

memory_candidates.description: Learnings proposed for memory promotion out of this operation (today: substrate/organism/memory_promotion.py decision path).

rollback.description: Rollback plan declared before execution and whether it was exercised.

tenant.description: Optional tenant scoping (org_id/user_id) — flagged by B1/B3 as missing on several current types.
